craft_notes: Sthāyin: grace discriminations. Rows: grace, above-Māyā, above-kalā. Read aloud: ladder climbed.

lines: Who rule the Māyā-womb, by some Ish's grace
when their action all falls dead — discernment seeps
of Man from Māyā: above Māyā the sage
keeps lone; below her never the kalā-self call,
l4.sanskrit_cite: māyāgarbhādhikāriṇas tu kasyacid īśvarasya prasādāt sarvakarmakṣaye māyāpuruṣaviveko bhavati yena māyordhve vijñānākala āste na jātucit māyādhaḥ kalāpuṃviveko vā yena kalordhve tiṣṭhati
